name: Gomer
summary: The daughter of Diblaim, whom the prophet Hosea married when the LORD told him to take an unfaithful wife. Her children were given names that carried God's message to Israel.

key_moments.title: Married to Hosea
key_moments.description: Because the land had turned away from the LORD, He told Hosea to take an unfaithful wife. Hosea married Gomer, and she bore him a son.

key_moments.title: Bears Children Named by God
key_moments.description: Gomer's children were named by God: a son Jezreel, a daughter Lo-ruhamah, meaning no more mercy, and a son Lo-ammi, meaning not My people.
